prose.name: Strike: Toll Ship over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A crew in orbit over <Planet> has been stopping haulers and taking one container from each as a toll. They keep everything they've taken in their own hold.
prose.card: Strike contract. A hostile vessel over <Planet> is extorting cargo from passing haulers. Destroy it and recover the seized cargo. Expect resistance. Payment on contract completion.

beats._target: A hostile ship, as 28a's. Not an Npc.
beats.journal: The toll ship over <Planet> is gone. Everything it took off the haulers is somewhere in what's left of it.
say: That's them finished. Their hold will have come apart with the rest of them, so look through what's floating.

beats.objective: Recover the seized cargo from the wreck
beats.journal: I recovered the cargo the toll crew took off the haulers over <Planet>. Most of it still has its owners' marks on it.
say: I can see my own container on your manifest from here. I'll put the word out so everyone who paid them can claim theirs.

broadcast: That's the ship that's been stopping us. They took one container off me last week and another this morning, and they're sitting on all of it, so take them apart and get our cargo back out of what's left.
_speech: A hauler who's had enough. The male voice from 23a; his ear decides.
